description: UFS vendor/manufacturer identifiers observed in the MediaTek Preloader parser's UFS vendor constants. These are UFS-specific values and must not be confused with the 8-bit eMMC CID MID.
notes: This is a source-observed subset, not a complete current JEDEC UFS manufacturer allocation table.
Micron MP and ES are kept as distinct values because the source defines two separate constants.
When reading UFS descriptors, preserve the raw 16-bit value and its byte order before applying this mapping.
